name: local-worker-mcp
description: MCP server exposing a local Ollama model as an agentic worker (its own tool-calling loop: files, web search) -- callable from Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Continue, or any MCP client.

scripts.build: esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/server.js --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start
